## Accepted scope

The general original-edge disk-face assertion in TOPP Problem 42 is false. The accepted prior result is Zachary Abel, Erik D. Demaine, and Martin L. Demaine, [*A Topologically Convex Vertex-Ununfoldable Polyhedron*](https://cccg.ca/proceedings/2011/papers/paper85.pdf), CCCG 2011, Theorem 4 and Figure 5.

The explicit perturbed twelve-face witness is an embedded closed polyhedral sphere with disk faces. Every possible original incidence connecting its two face classes forces positive-area local overlap, even with arbitrary vertex-hinge rotations or reflections. The full authored coordinate list, cyclic face boundaries, solid/radial construction, exposed-facet and disk-face argument, mixed-incidence classification, and strict-angle proof are preserved.

The witness is geometrically nonconvex and has nonconvex octagonal faces. The separate geometrically convex polyhedron clause and intermediate convex-face question are not resolved here. This does not mark the complete problem solved or make a global-openness claim about those residual questions.

## Evidence, review, and qualifications

The original authored audit is preserved byte-for-byte except for one provenance-only edition notice inserted after the unchanged title. Its original recommendation and pending-review wording are historical; ACCEPTANCE.md records the subsequent separate independent AI review. That review read the full proof, checked the U/V boundary-exposure and angle computations, viewed all three 2011 source pages, and independently replayed the repaired eight-case normal/optimized validator suite as supplementary checking.

This theoretical edition includes no checker scripts, fixtures, witness/validator result files, or execution logs. Their historical mentions remain in the unchanged audit. No code has been rewritten as prose to replace a missing proof; the full existing written argument is the accepted basis. The auxiliary historical 3-connectivity check does not enter the general disk-face negative conclusion.

The paper is listed in the [official CCCG 2011 proceedings](https://cccg.ca/proceedings/2011/). The [author bibliography](https://erikdemaine.org/papers/VertexUnunfoldable_CCCG2011/) explicitly marks it unrefereed and retains a stale “to appear” field. It is a published conference result, not a journal publication or independently verified peer-reviewed result.

Garcia–Gutierrez–Ruiz–Winslow's [CCCG 2018 orthogonal paper](https://andrewwinslow.com/papers/vufortho-cccg18.pdf) is corroborating context, not an independently accepted complete proof dependency. The audit retains its full limitations about figure-dependent notch placement, local “all other locations” wording, and putt/ell terminology. The original model/pagination distinctions for the foundational fifteen-page manuscript also remain intact.

The public source catalogue retains six checked source identities: five PDF records, including the identical 2011 author/official copies, and one TOPP HTML record. All were rehashed for this edition. The original inspection record is byte-identical. The source-version comparison preserves all six 2018 page indices and exact-match-after-footer-removal flags, its timestamp, and the 2011 author/official byte-match finding. Only the twelve derived page-text fingerprint fields are omitted, as documented in PROVENANCE.md; raw public-PDF hashes remain in the catalogue. These are public provenance metadata, not copied source content or computational proof results. Historical inspection is not presented as a new reading pass during packaging.

This is verification of an existing result, with zero new substantive proof-search approaches, no novelty or historical-priority claim, and no new search campaign. The reviews are AI mathematical/source audits, not human peer review or formal proof-assistant verification.

## Exact addition-only scope

Add exactly the ten files below under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/5500042/`. They comprise the full authored audit, acceptance, clause/status records, public source metadata and inspection history, provenance, and a noncircular manifest. The originals remain untouched.

No copied third-party source PDFs, text or images, dataset contents, private sources, private inventories or their digests, or private coordination material are included. No QUEUE.md or unrelated repository file is changed. Hashing and add-only patch replay validate packaging integrity only.
